recommendedTextbook.title: Basic Science for Junior Secondary Schools 3
recommendedTextbook.author: F.O.C. Ndu, P. Asun, J.O. Aina
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

subtopics: Fundamental particles of an atom (protons, neutrons, electrons)
Atomic number, mass number, and electronic configuration (first 20 elements)
Types of chemical bonds: electrovalent and covalent bonding
objectives: State charges, relative masses, and locations of subatomic particles
Write electronic configuration of elements from Hydrogen to Calcium (Z=1 to 20)
Illustrate formation of sodium chloride (NaCl) using electron transfer diagrams

topics.topic: Metals and Non-Metals: Properties and Rusting Mechanics
subtopics: Physical and chemical properties of metals vs non-metals
Conditions necessary for rusting of iron (water and oxygen)
Rust prevention techniques (painting, galvanizing, electroplating, greasing)
objectives: Compare electrical conductivity, malleability, and ductility of metals and non-metals
Design controlled laboratory experiment investigating rusting of iron nails
Explain corrosion prevention on Nigerian coastal steel bridges and corrugated roofs

topics.topic: Human Genetics and Heredity: Traits and Variation
subtopics: Meaning of genetics, heredity, and biological variation
Continuous vs discontinuous variation (height vs tongue rolling / blood group)
Transmission of parental traits via chromosomes and genes
objectives: Distinguish between continuous and discontinuous variations in human populations
Survey class population for observable genetic traits (albinism, earlobes, finger prints)
Draw Mendelian single-trait inheritance crosses

topics.topic: Human Nervous System and Reflex Actions
subtopics: Parts of the human nervous system (Central Nervous System and Peripheral Nervous System)
Structure of a neuron (cell body, dendrites, axon)
Reflex arc and involuntary actions (knee-jerk, withdrawing hand from hot pot)
objectives: Identify components of the human brain (cerebrum, cerebellum, medulla oblongata)
Diagram a motor neuron with labeled myelinated sheath
Trace reflex pathway through sensory receptor, spinal cord, and effector muscle

topics.topic: Human Sense Organs: Anatomy of Eye and Ear
subtopics: Structure and function of the human eye
Eye defects and optical corrections (myopia, hypermetropia, astigmatism)
Structure of the ear and mechanism of hearing / balance
objectives: Draw longitudinal section of the human eye showing cornea, lens, retina, and optic nerve
Explain optical correction of short-sightedness using concave diverging lenses
Describe role of semicircular canals in posture and spatial equilibrium

subtopics: Properties of magnets and magnetic poles (North and South)
Magnetic fields and field lines mapping using iron filings and compasses
Electromagnets: construction and practical applications (electric bells, scrap lifters)
objectives: Demonstrate fundamental law of magnetism: like poles repel, unlike poles attract
Map magnetic field lines surrounding bar magnets
Construct functional electromagnet using an iron nail, copper wire, and dry cell battery

subtopics: Evaluation of atomic theory, nervous system, genetics, and electromagnetism
BECE standardized past question clinic
objectives: Assess pupil mastery against Lagos State BECE examination standards

topics.topic: Electrical Energy, Circuits and Ohm's Law
subtopics: Electric current, potential difference (voltage), and electrical resistance
Series and parallel circuit connections
Ohm's Law: V = I × R and circuit calculations
objectives: Connect functional series and parallel circuits using ammeters and voltmeters
State Ohm's Law and calculate resistance in domestic appliances
Analyze why domestic wiring in Nigerian homes uses parallel circuits

subtopics: Meaning of radioactivity and discovery
Types of nuclear radiation (Alpha, Beta, Gamma rays) and their penetration powers
Peaceful applications (cancer radiotherapy, nuclear power) and safety hazards
objectives: Compare ionizing and penetration capacities of alpha, beta, and gamma emissions
Describe radioactive isotope applications in Nigerian agricultural research and medicine
State radiation shielding safety protocols

topics.topic: Environmental Health: Deforestation and Bush Burning
subtopics: Ecological hazards of uncontrolled bush burning in Nigerian agricultural zones
Deforestation consequences (desert encroachment, loss of biodiversity, global warming)
Conservation measures: afforestation and reforestation programs
objectives: Analyze destruction of soil nitrogen-fixing bacteria caused by seasonal bush burning
Explain link between tropical deforestation and climate change
Participate in school tree planting campaigns to combat soil erosion

topics.topic: Skill Acquisition and Science Technology in Nigeria
subtopics: Meaning and significance of technological skill acquisition
Indigenous Nigerian scientific technologies (cloth weaving, blacksmithing, leather tanning)
Modern STEM careers and entrepreneurship opportunities for secondary school leavers
objectives: Relate indigenous manufacturing skills in Kano, Aba, and Oyo to modern science
Formulate a mini science enterprise project proposal

topics.topic: BECE Mock Examination Clinic & Practical Revision
subtopics: Review of core 3-year junior secondary science syllabus
Standardized BECE test strategies and Chief Examiner report insights
objectives: Solve 50 standardized BECE objective and essay questions under timed conditions

subtopics: BECE Final Examination administration and script moderation
objectives: Complete junior secondary basic science certification
